# technitium_settings_tsig (Data Source)

Reads what `technitium_settings_tsig` manages, without managing it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The identifier, as the resource has it.
- `tsig_keys` (Attributes Set) The TSIG keys. An empty set removes all keys. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tsig_keys))

<a id="nestedatt--tsig_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tsig_keys`

Read-Only:

- `algorithm_name` (String) The HMAC algorithm: `hmac-md5.sig-alg.reg.int`, `hmac-sha1`, `hmac-sha256`, `hmac-sha256-128`, `hmac-sha384`, `hmac-sha384-192`, `hmac-sha512` or `hmac-sha512-256`.
- `key_name` (String) The key name. The server stores it in lower case without a trailing dot.
- `shared_secret` (String, Sensitive) The base64 encoded shared secret.
